visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white Bichon Frise dog with fluffy fur wearing a pink floral-patterned sweater stands behind a bright white cafe counter. The dog has a happy expression with its mouth open. The background is a clean, well-lit cafe with coffee equipment and a large orange sign that says 'Spark up every moment.' (2) The scene cuts to a Corgi wearing a light blue pajama-style shirt with floral prints, standing behind a wooden counter of a tea shop branded 'Tea & Magic Hand.' The dog tilts its head and moves its paws as if dancing. (3) A Husky in a similar light blue floral shirt is positioned behind a green counter of a 'Ching Shin Fu Chuan' shop. The Husky opens its mouth wide as if howling, with a menu displayed on the counter in front of it. (4) A Beagle wearing a blue floral shirt stands behind a 'Milksha' counter. The dog uses its paw to ring a metal service bell on the counter while looking at a tablet screen displaying an advertisement. (5) A Shiba Inu wearing a blue floral shirt stands behind a 'MACU' tea shop counter. A drink in a plastic cup is on the counter, and the dog leans down to take a sip from it. (6) A black French Bulldog in a yellow floral sweater stands behind a '50 Lan' counter. A human hand enters from the left holding a burger, which the dog bites and eats with an enthusiastic expression.
